sources.snippet: Overview Mistral-Nemo-Instruct-2407 is a 12-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model developed jointly by mistralai and NVIDIA. This transformer model features 40 layers, 5,120-dimensional embeddings, 32 attention heads with 8 key-value heads using grouped query attention, and supports a 128,000-token context window.
